findings.current: He’d revealed their deepest secrets, but that didn’t mean they could accept everything in such a short time.
findings.defect: “Their deepest secrets” makes the listeners the owners of the secrets Jin disclosed.
findings.rationale: Jin has confided secrets to the group; the Korean does not call them the listeners’ secrets.
findings.replacement: He’d shared the deepest secrets with them, but that didn’t mean they could accept everything so quickly.
findings.source: 가장 깊은 비밀들을 털어놓았지만, 그 짧은 시간 만에 모든 것을 수용하고 받아들인 것은 아니다.

findings.current: Song Song, the only one occupying a seat among all the men built like mountains, glanced at the space beside her.
findings.defect: “The only one occupying a seat” implies the men are not seated.
findings.rationale: The Korean singles her out among the large men, not as the only person seated.
findings.replacement: Song Song, sitting alone among the mountain-sized men, glanced at the spot beside her.
findings.source: 덩치가 산만 한 남자들 사이에서 홀로 한 자리를 차지하고 있던 송송이가 눈짓으로 옆자리를 가리켰다.

findings.current: Or his family, and Seong Jinho, who’d been his closest friend since his days at the goshiwon—people who wouldn’t be able to accept a situation like this.
findings.defect: The draft extends Jin’s judgment that they could not accept this situation to Seong Jinho.
findings.rationale: The Korean attaches that judgment to his family; it describes Seong Jinho by their long friendship.
findings.replacement: Or his family, who wouldn’t be able to accept a situation like this, and Seong Jinho, his closest friend since his days at the goshiwon.
findings.source: 혹은 이런 상황을 받아들이지 못할 가족과 고시원 시절부터 절친했던 성진호처럼.

findings.current:
A broken pocket watch.

It was probably moving—the thing that connected the modern world and Murim through the absolute force of time.
findings.defect: The draft makes the watch’s movement uncertain instead of its role in connecting the worlds.
findings.rationale: The Korean states that the watch was moving and qualifies the proposed connection with “probably.”
findings.replacement:
The broken pocket watch.

It was moving—the thing that probably linked the modern world and Murim through the absolute force of time.
findings.source:
고장난 회중시계.

아마도 현대와 무림, 두 세상을 시간이라는 절대적인 힘으로 잇고 있을 그것이 움직이고 있었다.

findings.defect: The reply becomes a rebuke of the servant rather than a denial that the process is complete.
findings.rationale: The answer responds to “Has it finally been completed?” and is followed by “But it will be completed.”

findings.current: The voice was too cold as ice to be called a voice, but the Grand Mage trembled with joy and emotion.
findings.defect: The English makes coldness the reason it can scarcely be called a voice; it also reads awkwardly.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes an almost voiceless communication and its icy quality separately.
findings.replacement: What reached her could scarcely be called a voice. It was cold as ice, but the Grand Mage trembled with joy.
findings.source: 음성이라 부를 수 없을 것 같은 그것은 얼음장처럼 차가웠으나, 대술사는 기쁨과 감격으로 몸을 떨었다.

findings.current: Her servant’s question was thick with unconcealed emotion. Her master answered.
findings.defect: “Her servant” momentarily makes the Grand Mage the servant’s master.
findings.rationale: The Grand Mage is the servant asking the question; the Lord of Heaven is her master.
findings.replacement: The servant’s question was thick with unconcealed joy. Her master answered.
findings.source: 숨길 수 없는 감격이 묻어나오는 종의 물음에, 주인이 답했다.

summary: Several draft lines change whose secrets were shared, why people were not invited, and the Lord of Heaven’s reply.
